name: dishtansya-api
description: Dishtansya food delivery API (Registration, Login, Order)

scripts.migrate: npm run gconfig && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -O '{ "module": "CommonJS" }' ./node_modules/.bin/sequelize db:migrate
scripts.migrate:undo: npm run gconfig && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -O '{ "module": "CommonJS" }' ./node_modules/.bin/sequelize db:migrate:undo
scripts.migrate:undo:all: npm run gconfig && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -O '{ "module": "CommonJS" }' ./node_modules/.bin/sequelize db:migrate:undo:all
scripts.seed: npm run gconfig && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -r ./src/database/associations -O '{ "module": "CommonJS" }' ./node_modules/.bin/sequelize db:seed:all
scripts.seed:undo:all: npm run gconfig && ts-node -r tsconfig-paths/register -r ./src/database/associations -O '{ "module": "CommonJS" }' ./node_modules/.bin/sequelize db:seed:undo:all
scripts.db:setup: npm run migrate && npm run seed
